title: Mr Philip Beaufoy
html_source:
Bloom read Mr Beaufoy’s story while in the outhouse in Chapter 4 and considered submitting a story.
“Our prize titbit: MATCHAM’S MASTERSTROKE. Written by Mr Philip Beaufoy, Playgoers' Club, London. Payment at the rate of one guinea a column has been made to the writer.”
